note: grave (Grave — AR/Wind) — whole-kit Overheat model. Pinned by scripts/tests/units/grave.test.ts (23 pins). || S1 'Heat Emission' is her DEFAULT, non-Prediction state and is held most of the fight, so its team grants are modeled as passives: Burst Gauge filling speed 38.96% (all allies) and Pierce Damage 48.4% (allies, excludeSelf). The excludeSelf is faithful, not a fudge: grave has Pierce only during Prediction, when Heat Emission is OFF, so she can never benefit from her own 48.4 — and excluding her also prevents a burst-window double-count. Allies still receive it (inert unless pierce-tagged). ⛑ the passive treatment slightly overcounts during her ~10s Prediction windows, when Heat Emission is genuinely off; there is no status-end trigger primitive to gate it. || RELOAD IS A DAMAGE LINE, and hers is MEASURED (grave solo.MP4, Shooting Range = scope-lock per owner): the real reload gap is 3.35s / 201 frames last-shot-landing to first-shot-landing (n=19 clean reloads, tight 2.85-3.52s, counter frame-diff method), against the datamined 81f (~92f effective). Modeled as charFixes.reloadFrames 193, which resolves to reloadFramesNeeded(193,0) = 201f — reproducing the measured gap AND composing correctly with any real reload-speed buff, which a synthetic reloadSpeedPct would not. Direct count: 20 reloads = ~1230 shots. ⛑ MECHANISM: attributing this to the kit's 'Heat Emission: Reload Ratio ▼50%' is INFERRED, not isolated — she only ever reloads in Heat Emission, so '▼50% + overhead' and 'the datamined reloadFrames is simply wrong' are observationally identical. The operative value (201f) is measured; the attribution is best-candidate. Literal readings the measurement REFUTES: reloadSpeedPct −50 → 131f (too fast), speed-halved → ~184f (17f short), reload-AMOUNT-halved → refuted by 61.5 shots/gap = full 60-round mags. || PREDICTION-END AMMO REMOVAL IS MODELED: burstCast + block delaySec 10 → consumeAmmo fraction 1, emptying the magazine at Prediction end and forcing the ~201f reload, on her own casts only. || S2 Overheat ramp: Overheat I (+15.48% ATK after 15 normal hits, kit-cleared on a full reload) is a hitCount-15 self buff approximated as sustained — the per-reload reset is absorbed by that approximation (hand decision). Overheat II (+20.66% ATK, 30 hits) and Overheat III (+30.8% Attack Damage, 60 hits) exist only while in Prediction, so both are tied to her burst cast for the 10s Prediction duration. ⛑ the 30/60-hit build-up is approximated as FULL-window uptime: at the measured 12.0 rounds/s under unlimited ammo that is a ~2.5s/~5s ramp-in, so durationSec 7.5/5.0 would equal real in-window uptime. This is a FINDING on the hand slot, deliberately not edited — it is one of the two live candidates for open-questions U19. || BURST: unlimited ammo 10s, self Pierce + Pierce Damage 52.8% + Critical Rate 85.19% (10s), team Attack Damage 48.2% + Pierce Damage 39.98% + Max Ammunition 3 rounds (10s). All values are literal kit text. 'Gain Pierce for 10 sec' is modeled faithfully via the engine gainPierce effect + pierceUntilFrame window, so during Prediction her attacks are pierce-tagged and her Pierce Damage ▲ entries land (self 52.8 + team 39.98 = +92.78 Damage Up). Pierce Damage ▲ is a real Damage-Up entry that applies on the partless boss (owner-confirmed); only the separate pierce CORE+BODY DOUBLE-HIT is multipart-only (PIERCE_CORE_DOUBLE=false) — do not conflate the two. || KNOWN RESIDUAL, DELIBERATE (owner-directed, faithful>fit): with the real pierce enabled her three comps read HOT (~1.178/1.171/1.219) rather than the 0.836/0.831/0.800 COLD they showed without it. The pierce is a real mechanic so it stays modeled; the remaining HOT is a SEPARATE, cleanly-isolated over-model in her burst window that the missing pierce had been masking as net-COLD. Tracked as open-questions U19 — do NOT re-fit it away by disabling pierce. Her solo reading (1.005) is unaffected: a lone B2 never bursts, so no pierce window opens. || Cadence tuple MEASURED (12.0 rounds/s steady + 201f effective reload, grave-solo-recon.json n=19) — no cadence ⛑. || The Heat-Emission self-heal (2% Max HP/1s) is unmodeled and genuinely inert cross-unit: it is SELF-targeted, so the recovery event fires on grave, who has no on-recovery trigger — unlike the helm→crown pairing it can never feed a teammate. The burst's HP-drain self-cost is skipped (defensive, no damage channel). 'Removes Heat Emission under certain conditions' is unmodeled: the kit does not state the condition.
